_comment: Policy for backup_data.py (decisions confirmed by the user 2026-10-30). skip_patterns: file names (regex) not backed up (converted copies of CVRs whose originals are backed up). skip_files: paths (relative to the data root) not backed up. replace_patterns: paths (regex) whose backup copy a newer source copy replaces (state files revised after download). cvr_compare_skip: CVR files left out of the cross-check tabulation. include_dirs / skip_dirs: folders to include although they start with '_', or to leave out (the user: never back up Election_CVRs\_Other-2022 Primary).
